## Static finding: producer contract open precedes regular-file rejection

Observed on default head `ac6e36eb8b3cd3e3efca61186be87d4ad3991fc1`, tree-equivalent to reviewed PR #190 head `f97cfef6bc5d72bf0881a061a366c0c8e1312127`. This is source analysis corroborating the owner's [review finding](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-beads/pull/190#pullrequestreview-5693702370), **not a locally reproduced FIFO test** and not a claim about an npm publication.

### Exact evidence
In [forecast.ts lines 159–172](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-beads/blob/ac6e36eb8b3cd3e3efca61186be87d4ad3991fc1/forecast.ts#L159-L172), `readBeadsProducerContract`:
1. awaits `open(file, "r")`;
2. only afterward calls `handle.stat()` and rejects `!info.isFile()`;
3. translates I/O errors into the typed `io_error` remedy requesting a readable regular contract file no larger than 65536 bytes.

The ordinary blocking read-only open can wait for a FIFO writer before the regular-file test is reached. Thus the nonregular-input rejection is too late to uphold the bounded regular-file input contract. The public SDK reader and CLI forecast route share this reader.

### Expected / impact
Reject nonregular contract input promptly with the existing typed refusal, without requiring another process to open the input or emit bytes. Preserve the 65536-byte cap and normal valid-file forecast semantics. A mistaken FIFO input can otherwise stall an agent's read-only compatibility/discovery workflow instead of returning an actionable receipt.

The [accepted forecast feature](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-beads/blob/ac6e36eb8b3cd3e3efca61186be87d4ad3991fc1/.agents/pm/features/pm-beads-5t1j.toon) calls for deterministic typed SDK/CLI compatibility receipts and remedies; the reader itself explicitly promises bounded nonregular-input handling.

### Acceptance / regression criteria
- Ensure input classification/opening cannot block waiting for a writer before the regular-file policy is enforced; retain safe handling if input changes during checking.
- Verify direct SDK and CLI JSON/TOON paths return the expected typed refusal within a bounded test deadline for supported nonregular-input cases, with isolated fixtures and guaranteed cleanup.
- Retain successful valid regular-file forecasts, malformed-contract refusals, and oversized/growing-file bounds without loosening limits.
- No tracker/provider mutation or unrelated dependency changes are required.

### Evidence limits / dedup
No FIFO, special-file or other security/path probe was executed in this review. The owner review reports the hang; this issue independently records the current source-order evidence. Existing all-status issues/PRs (191 records) and all 87 current canonical feature/issue/task records were checked. Earlier sidecar FIFO validation is a separate path, not a forecast-reader fix. No dedicated forecast open-order owner item was found.
Forecast contract reader can block before rejecting nonregular inputs

value.text: Triage 2026-11-02 (missed-watch sweep): still valid. Current main still opens the producer contract with a blocking read-only open() before handle.stat() rejects nonregular inputs (forecast.ts readBeadsProducerContract), so a FIFO input can stall the reader before the typed io_error refusal. No other open pm-beads item tracks this; this imported item is the single owner. Corroborates the owner review finding on merged PR #190.
